title: Refactor Global Variable Usage
problem_statement: Global variables are used for database connections, which can lead to maintainability and security issues.
risk_if_unaddressed: Increased risk of security vulnerabilities and code that is difficult to maintain.
suggested_approach: Refactor the code to use dependency injection for database connections.
success_criteria: No global variables used for database connections.

provenance.evidence: Global variable usage for database connection.

title: Mitigate SQL Injection Risk
problem_statement: SQL scripts lack parameterized queries, increasing the risk of SQL injection attacks.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential for SQL injection attacks compromising data integrity.
suggested_approach: Implement parameterized queries in SQL scripts.
success_criteria: Reduced risk of SQL injection attacks.
